description: This source file contains utility methods for working with queries in Hibernate Search within the OpenMRS project. Specifically, it provides functionality to escape special characters in query strings.

classes.name: SearchQueryUtils
classes.description: A utility class for escaping special characters in Hibernate Search query strings.

methods.name: escapeQuery
methods.description: Escapes special characters in the input query string such as ()*-+|~" to prevent issues in search queries.
